span.p:
CDN
video sabko dheemi, mehngi
-> video S3 me, CDN duniya bhar me copy rakhe
user ko paas wale CDN se, nahi mila to S3 se laaye (CDN)
photo hatayi, CDN pe dikhe -> CDN se hatao (invalidation)
private photo -> thodi der wala link (signed URL)
